title: Do technological and psychosocial factors influence the use of digital repositories in Malaysian technical universities? A multigroup analysis
core_idea: Assess how technological and psychosocial factors affect adoption of digital repositories among staff and students in the Malaysia Technical University Network by extending the UTAUT framework with a green attitude construct and applying a quantitative PLS-SEM approach.
tldr: Investigates determinants of digital repository adoption in Malaysian technical universities, integrating green attitude into UTAUT and using stratified sampling and PLS-SEM on 199 responses; framed by green computing and increased digital documentation since COVID-19.
